title: Socials — Utsah Events | Bardoli, Gujarat
description: Follow Utsah Events on Instagram, YouTube and WhatsApp. See our latest celebrations and moments.
headExtra:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400;1,600&family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@200;300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css?v=87">
<style>
    .socials-page { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
    .nav__logo { cursor: pointer; }
    @media (min-width: 431px) {
      #nav { transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) !important; }
      #dropdownBtn { transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 430px) {
      .nav { pointer-events: all !important; }
      .nav__logo { pointer-events: all !important; display: block; }
    }

    /* HERO */
    .socials-hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 140px 40px 80px;
      margin-top: 0;
    }
    .socials-hero__label { margin-top: 0; }
    .socials-hero__label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .socials-hero__title {
      font-family: 'Cinzel', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6.5vw, 5.5rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.0;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    /* Desktop only — matches the Times New Roman treatment on the home
       hero. Scoped above the tablet breakpoint so phone/tablet keep
       their existing Cinzel untouched. */
    @media (min-width: 1025px) {
      .socials-hero__title { font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; }
    }
    .socials-hero__title span { color: var(--maroon); }
    .socials-hero__sub {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.15rem);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 600;
      max-width: 460px;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }
    .socials-hero__divider {
      width: 60px;
      height: 2px;
      background: #FFD700;
      margin: 24px auto 0;
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,0.9), 0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,0.5);
    }
    /* Scroll cue — phones only, see media query below */
    .socials-hero__scroll { display: none; }

    /* SOCIAL LINKS ROW */
    .social-links {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 36px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .social-link-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 18px 32px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }
    .social-link-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); opacity: 0.9; }
    .social-link-card--instagram { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #833ab4, #fd1d1d, #fcb045); }
.social-link-card--whatsapp { background: #25d366; }
    .social-link-card--youtube { background: #FF0000; }
    .social-link-card svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* CTA BAR */
    .socials-cta {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 56px auto 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .socials-cta__card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 36px 32px;
      text-align: center;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      gap: 24px;
      color: #ffffff;

      /* Translucent frosted surface — maroon-tinted */
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,0.3) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,0.25) 100%);

      /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
      box-shadow:
        0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
        inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Standard glassmorphism fallback + layer initialization */
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
    }
    /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
    .socials-cta__card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
    }
    .socials-cta__title {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.6vw, 1.15rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      line-height: 1.4;
      text-align: center;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .socials-cta__sub { display: none; }
    .socials-cta__btn {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 11px 28px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.95) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 100%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      color: var(--maroon);
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-radius: 100px;
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .socials-cta__btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); opacity: 0.9; }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .insta-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .insta-item--tall { grid-row: span 1; aspect-ratio: 1; }
      .insta-item--wide { grid-column: span 2; }
      .social-links { gap: 12px; }
      .social-link-card { padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; }
      .youtube-section { padding: 20px 20px 60px; }
      .socials-cta { margin-top: 40px; }
    }

    /* ===== PHONES (≤430px) — iPhone 14/15/16, Pixel, Galaxy S ===== */
    @media (max-width: 430px) {
      /* Hero — compact type matching the about/events/contact heroes */
      .socials-hero { padding: 100px 20px 48px; min-height: 100svh; position: relative; }
      .socials-hero__label { font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
      .socials-hero__title { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 7vw, 2.1rem); line-height: 1.05; margin-bottom: 0; }
      .socials-hero__sub { font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; }
      .socials-hero__divider { margin-top: 16px; }

      /* Scroll cue — glowing, pulsing star + label pinned to the hero bottom */
      .socials-hero__scroll {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        position: absolute;
        bottom: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        font-family: var(--body);
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        font-weight: 900;
        letter-spacing: 0.2em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #c9a84c;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(201,168,76,0.9), 0 0 24px rgba(201,168,76,0.5);
        transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
      }
      .socials-hero__scroll-star {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        line-height: 1;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(201,168,76,1), 0 0 24px rgba(201,168,76,0.7), 0 0 44px rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
        animation: socialsStarPulse 2s ease infinite;
      }
      @keyframes socialsStarPulse {
        0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1); }
        50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.15); }
      }
      .socials-hero__scroll span { display: none; } /* "Scroll" label removed — star only */

      /* Instagram section */
      .insta-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
      .insta-item--wide { grid-column: span 2; }
      .insta-item--tall { grid-row: span 1; aspect-ratio: 1; }

      /* Instagram profile card */
      .ig-profile { padding: 20px 16px; border-radius: 16px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; }
      .ig-profile__avatar { width: 64px; height: 64px; font-size: 1.6rem; }
      .ig-profile__stats { justify-content: center; }

      /* Social links — icon-only circles, three across (Instagram/YouTube/WhatsApp) */
      .social-links { flex-direction: row; gap: 16px; margin-top: 24px; }
      .social-link-card {
        width: 52px;
        height: 52px;
        padding: 0;
        border-radius: 50%;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .social-link-card span { display: none; }
      .social-link-card--youtube { display: flex; }

      /* YouTube */
      .youtube-section { padding: 36px 20px 48px; }
      .youtube-section__title { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 6vw, 2.8rem); }
      .yt-embed { border-radius: 14px; }

      /* CTA */
      .socials-cta { margin-top: 36px; }
      .socials-cta__card {
        padding: 32px 20px;
        border-radius: 16px;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 20px;
      }
      .socials-cta__title { font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 5vw, 2rem); }
      .socials-cta__btn { width: 100%; text-align: center; }
    }

    /* ===== SMALLEST PHONES (≤375px) — iPhone SE, Galaxy A-series ===== */
    @media (max-width: 375px) {
      .socials-hero { padding: 90px 16px 40px; }
      .socials-hero__title { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 9vw, 2.2rem); }
      .youtube-section { padding: 24px 16px 40px; }
      .socials-cta { margin-top: 28px; }
      .socials-cta__card { padding: 24px 16px; }
    }
  </style>
